sections.content: Some verbs end in *-ik* in the dictionary: *dolgozik* (works), *reggelizik* (has breakfast). You already know one, *lakik*, from *lakom* and *laksz*. With “he” and “she” the *-ik* stays: *Anna dolgozik.* A regular verb has no ending there: *Anna olvas.*

sections.title: The other persons
sections.content: For you, we, you all and they, an *-ik* verb takes the same endings as the verbs you know: *dolgozol*, *dolgozunk*, *dolgoztok*, *dolgoznak*. The next screen shows “I”.
Keep the *-ik* with “he” and “she”: *Anna dolgozik*, not *Anna dolgoz*.
